about.title: About us
about.intro: {brand} is an Egyptian furniture store combining modern design with lasting quality.

sections.title: Our story
sections.body: We started with a simple idea: every home deserves beautiful, comfortable furniture at a fair price. Today we hand-pick every piece and follow it through production so it reaches you in perfect shape.

sections.title: What we offer
sections.body: Bedrooms, living rooms, dining sets, bedding and decor, delivered nationwide with cash on delivery.

sections.title: Our promise
sections.body: Trusted materials, clear prices with no hidden fees, and support that stays with you after delivery.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: We respect your privacy. This page explains what {brand} collects and how we use and protect it.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: Your name, email, mobile number, the delivery addresses you enter and your order details.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.body: To fulfil and communicate about your orders and to improve our service. We never sell your data.

sections.title: Keeping it safe
sections.body: Passwords are encrypted and never visible to anyone, and connections to the site are secured.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can edit your details from your account or contact us to delete your account.

terms.title: Terms & conditions
terms.intro: By using the {brand} website you agree to the following terms.

sections.title: Orders and prices
sections.body: Prices are in Egyptian pounds. Orders are confirmed after review and a call from our team.

sections.title: Availability
sections.body: We keep stock up to date; if an item becomes unavailable after you order, we'll let you know and cancel it at no cost.

sections.title: Your account
sections.body: You're responsible for keeping your sign-in details private and for activity on your account.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time; changes apply from the date they're published.

shippingReturns.title: Shipping & returns
shippingReturns.intro: Everything you need to know about {brand} deliveries and returns.

sections.title: Where and when
sections.body: We deliver across Egypt within 3 to 10 business days depending on the area and stock.

sections.title: Shipping fees
sections.body: Fees depend on your city and the order weight and are shown before you confirm. Some products ship free.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: You can request a return within 14 days of delivery if the item is unused and in its original condition.

sections.title: Damaged items
sections.body: Inspect your order on delivery; if anything is damaged, contact us right away and we'll replace it at our cost.
